database: PGlite PostgreSQL engine; no native TCP or multiple processes
limitations: Local synthetic identity and one checkout; not production latency/load/billing
Body bytes exclude HTTP/TLS headers and 24-hour keepalive/reconnect overhead
Native cross-instance PostgreSQL/TCP is tested by CI when TEST_DATABASE_URL is present
Vercel and database usage may rise while streams keep functions/compute active; no zero-cost guarantee
No production trigger, endpoint or polling change
